agency.name: Nevada Division of Public and Behavioral Health (DPBH), Department of Health and Human Services

narrNote: No Nevada affiliate appears on NARR's official affiliate list (narronline.org/affiliates, fetched 2026-10-22). Nevada recovery residences ('halfway houses for recovering alcohol and drug abusers,' NRS 449.0045) are certified directly by the Nevada Department of Health and Human Services / DPBH, which adapts the NARR standard, so certification runs through the state rather than a NARR affiliate.
notes: DPBH, within Nevada DHHS, is Nevada's Single State Agency for substance use per the SAMHSA/NASADAD SSA directory, confirmed at dpbh.nv.gov (fetched 2026-10-22); its Bureau of Behavioral Health Wellness and Prevention (formerly SAPTA) administers substance-use services. Nevada 988 is administered by DPBH in partnership with Carelon Behavioral Health; Crisis Support Services of Nevada serves as Northern and Rural Nevada's 988 crisis contact center (call or text 988, 24/7). Foundation for Recovery is Nevada's statewide peer-run Recovery Community Organization, verified at forrecovery.org (fetched 2026-10-22). Nevada 211 (fetched 2026-10-22) offers statewide ZIP-level search: call 2-1-1 or 1-866-535-5654, or text a ZIP code to 898211. medicaidSud is null: Nevada Medicaid (Division of Health Care Financing and Policy) publishes behavioral-health coverage through its Medicaid Services Manual and provider portal at medicaid.nv.gov, and no member-facing Medicaid substance-use page could be verified in this run - no URL was guessed. countyDirectory is null: no separate verified county-level directory exists; Nevada 211 fills that role statewide.
